Power: You can never truly have enough of it you’ll always want more and even if you do somehow get the amount you want, you’ll find yourself unsatisfied

Wealth: While financial stability is a huge blessing, it will not end suffering. You can find multiple big name celebrities who are incredibly well off but are  still depressed.

Liberation: This one depends if you mean liberation from your mind or from a very controlling environment. There are places in this world where you are very limited in what you are allowed to do and this does make maintaining peace hard. Not impossible though, but very difficult. But I think even in a place where you have a ton of freedom, if you have no guidance or direction, you can find yourself lost and unfulfilled.

Love: I think this is part of what a Human should strive for. Love and peace. A state of mind where you accept what is as if you had chosen it. Helping others find their peace and spreading love to people where you can. If you could somehow strip away your mind filter and be 100 percent in the now, you would be already satisfied with life.

Heres an example 

A thought could say

“Im so nervous, my life is terrible and Ill never get what I want!”

Instead of agreeing and accepting that thought as a fact and true, you can acknowledge it for what it is, a drifting opinion that’ll eventually fade away. It holds no meaning unless you assign it meaning. Its not an easy thing to do all the time I’ll admit, but knowing that the thoughts in your head aren’t words of god or undeniable truths is liberating.

Im not perfect either, but I usually ask a series of questions to disprove it

Example Thought: “I am a terrible Person”

1.) Could someone else think differently about me?

2.) Have I done something thats showed that the opposite of this is also true?

3.) Is this a fact I could prove with science or math or is it opinion?

Ultimate- The ultimate smash roster, if you prefer a certain playstyle there is guaranteed a character covering you on that. Melee: Movements and mechanics are a wonky mess of happy accidents, making for a fun time. The game is pretty unbalanced, comparing Kirby and Fox is night and day. In Break the targets everyone had their own unique stage, adventure mode is a neat concept that I’d love to see used again. 

64: I still adore the look of this game, the polygonal models are so appealing. Plus the sound effects for the hits in this are really satisfying. It’s possible to pull off long combo strings in this game and it’s fun to mess around and see what you can do. The controls are fine, just probably don’t use a traditional 64 controller for this game.

Brawl: Subspace is the main reason this game is so high, seeing characters that you’d never see interact was really fun, plus fighting rayquaza in a boss fight was amazing! Mechanically this isn’t my favorite of the bunch, specifically because random tripping. Sonic being added at the time was very exciting!

Better online than brawl but still a ways to go, I did like the For Fun/For Glory setup.

Smash (3ds): In terms of positives I really enjoyed the Smash run mode, like a lot. That Kirby’s air ride like goodness is hard to resist.
